key_insight: Mangrove drag is not uniform with height: root characteristics create a species-dependent, frequency-selective wave attenuation effect that classical vegetation models miss.
engineering_relevance: The paper offers a simplified mangrove representation that can be used in CFD and experimental setups to better design and assess nature-based coastal protection.
method: Generalised the vertical vegetation biomass profile across mangrove species.
Derived a wave attenuation model that explicitly includes mangrove root characteristics.
Built a simplified drag-profile-preserving model for OpenFOAM and lab fabrication.
evidence_signal: OpenFOAM simulations were used to evaluate hydrodynamic performance and showed nonlinear, species-dependent wave attenuation.
watch_item: The simplified representation may not capture all real-root structural variability, so species-specific calibration is likely needed.
paper_title: On the Modelling of the Hydrodynamic Drag of Mangroves
